sections.name: the_lab
sections.camera: a sealed lab at night: an alarm, a radio, a case on a bench

sections.name: the_take
sections.camera: the Hero takes the device and runs for the bike; the gate opens

sections.name: the_alert
sections.camera: the Villain finds the empty case; the Hero is already on the highway

sections.name: the_chase
sections.camera: a tunnel bore and open road: the black car closes, the bike drifts

sections.name: the_flyover
sections.camera: high angle over the flyover deck: the car alongside

sections.name: the_truck
sections.camera: a truck, an air horn, one second of nothing

sections.name: the_escalation
sections.camera: handheld, low to the road: a hard drift, the car tries to ram

sections.name: the_wall
sections.camera: the widest shot and the loudest bars: the barrier, the tunnel again

sections.name: the_dropout
sections.camera: the music leaves: two engines idling, a radio, a breath

sections.name: the_signal
sections.camera: the bike stops; the case opens; the device pulses; cut to black
